datasets.name: ActiveCustomerList
datasets.sql:
SELECT customers.rowID, 
       id, op_id, open_dat, close_dat, nerezident,
       prinad_kod, name, short_name, group_klie, vid_sob,
       org_sob, sfera_dey, otrasl, nalog_kod, kod_okpro,
       inn, dat_nal, dat_ustav, bik , translate(name, 'IiİiIı', '``````') as name1,
      decode(nvl(customers.cust_type,0), 0, 'huquqi', 1, 'fiziki', 2, 'f.s.') tip
FROM customers
where CLOSE_DAT IS NULL
order by :Title

datasets.name: ActiveAccountList
datasets.sql:
select
  acc.ID,
  acc.ACC_NO as AccNo,
  acc.NAME as AccName,
  acc.OPEN_DAT as OpenDate,
  'AHA' as CurrencySName,
  T.OSTAT as Balance,
  T.POK_OSTAT as LBalance
from
  Account acc,
  tenostat t
where
  (CLOSE_DAT IS NULL)
  and (acc.KLI_ID = :ID)
  and (T.ACC_ID = acc.ID)
union all
select
  acc.ID,
  acc.ACC_NO as AccNo,
  acc.NAME as AccName,
  acc.OPEN_DAT as OpenDate,
  'AHA' as CurrencySName,
  T.OSTAT as Balance,
  T.POK_OSTAT as LBalance
from
  out_Account acc,
  out_tenostat t
where
  (CLOSE_DAT IS NULL)
  and (acc.KLI_ID = :ID)
  and (T.ACC_ID = acc.ID)
